title: Identification of potential regulators of caffeine biosynthesis in shading- and nano‑selenium-treated tea leaves based on integrated bioinformatics and AlphaFold3 analysis.
authors: Ye, Jianhui; Han, Qianou; Zhu, Jin; Li, Chunyang
one_liner_zh: 该文结合转录组与AlphaFold3预测TF-DNA复合物，筛选调控茶树咖啡碱合成的转录因子，属于蛋白质-DNA互作建模在植物代谢调控中的应用，方法可迁移至TF-DNA研究，但对象非典型TF-DNA机制建模，深度有限。
abstract: Caffeine is an important flavor and bioactive compound in tea, yet external stimuli-induced regulatory networks of caffeine biosynthesis remain largely unclear. Our study showed that shading and nano‑selenium (SeNPs) treatments respectively increased caffeine content in tea leaves from 35.96 mg/g to approximately 43 mg/g, whereas their combined treatment exerted a synergistic effect, raising it to 51.12 mg/g. Correlation of transcriptome with caffeine content and treatment factors via WGCNA and Mantel tests identified 4 key gene modules and 64 transcription factors (TFs). To accelerate TF screening, we established a rapid and high-throughput screening strategy by integrating AlphaFold3 with JASPAR motif prediction, resulting in 10 candidate TF-DNA complexes. Subsequent validation in yeast and tobacco systems confirmed that CsTSO1 directly binds to the promoter of CsSAMS. Our study uncovers how shading and SeNPs modulate caffeine biosynthesis in tea plants, and provide an AI-assisted framework for efficient TF screening in plant metabolic network.
abstract_zh: 咖啡因是茶叶中重要的风味和生物活性化合物，然而外部刺激诱导的咖啡因生物合成调控网络仍 largely 不清楚。我们的研究表明，遮荫和纳米硒（SeNPs）处理分别将茶叶中的咖啡因含量从35.96 mg/g提高至约43 mg/g，而它们的联合处理则产生协同效应，将其提升至51.12 mg/g。通过WGCNA和Mantel检验将转录组与咖啡因含量及处理因素相关联，鉴定出4个关键基因模块和64个转录因子（TFs）。为加速TF筛选，我们通过整合AlphaFold3与JASPAR基序预测，建立了一种快速且高通量的筛选策略，从而获得10个候选TF-DNA复合物。随后在酵母和烟草系统中的验证确认，CsTSO1直接结合CsSAMS的启动子。我们的研究揭示了遮荫和SeNPs如何调控茶树中的咖啡因生物合成，并为植物代谢网络中的高效TF筛选提供了一个AI辅助框架。
